text: Eight commands. Everything else in the file is a comment, so the notes at the top avoid dots, commas and hyphens.
Cells start at 0x4000 in the banked window. hello.bf touches only a handful of bytes; the writes cluster in one page.
With the tapes lever at 2 the cells move to tape 1. Select tape 1 here and tape 0's window stays empty.
Each . is a CONOUT syscall: RUNNING -> SYSCALL -> RUNNING once per character.
